head_commit.message:
fix(release): verify final branch reference identity

Validate the full live branch reference before tags and package pushes.
Require the final source check for protected executed-mode releases while
keeping local qualification offline and preserving exact CI run and attempt
binding.

Retain the newer final prepare hook, publisher and prerelease controls,
and name the shell fixture argument for static analysis.

repository.description: Common project for building Hexalith applications, modules and libraries

steps.name: Require exact current branch and successful push CI
Recheck approved release source and push CI
Authenticate to NuGet.org with Trusted Publishing
